_comment: M-CONCIERGE-ASSIGNMENT test payloads. POST each variant individually to the scenario webhook URL. Replace the webhook URL with the one generated by Make after import.

A_concierge_found_miami_sss._description: Happy path — Miami, She Said Sail. Expects a concierge with City=MIA, Brand=SSS, Status=ACTIVE, Available=true to exist in Concierge_Operators. Verify: Request status → CONCIERGE_ASSIGNED, concierge email sent, Slack LOW alert fired, audit CONCIERGE_ASSIGNED logged.

B_concierge_found_tampa_sss._description: Happy path — Tampa, She Said Sail. Expects a concierge with City=TPA, Brand=SSS. Verify correct concierge is matched (not Miami concierge).

C_concierge_found_charleston_mare._description: Happy path — Charleston, Mare Executive. Tests brand isolation — only a MARE_EXECUTIVE concierge should be returned, not an SSS concierge in the same city.

D_no_concierge_available._description: No-match path — use a city/brand combination guaranteed to return zero results (e.g., TPA + MARE_EXECUTIVE if no such concierge exists, or temporarily mark all matching concierges as Available=false). Verify: Request status → NEEDS_MANUAL_ASSIGNMENT, HIGH urgency AUTOMATION_ERROR Slack alert fired, audit ASSIGNMENT_FAILED logged.

E_invalid_request_id._description: Error path — bogus Airtable record ID. Module 2 (ActionGetRecord) should throw an error. Verify: Error handler fires, SCENARIO_ERROR audit event logged, Slack error alert in #sss-ops-alerts.

F_production_sample_sss_miami._description: Production-format reference payload. Replace request_id with a real Airtable record ID before sending. environment = production. Only use when ready to write real records.
